test_configs.label: Test R — binary, WELLBEING_CONCERN_PROMPT (production binary path)

4-axis with long guardrails (WELLBEING_CLASSIFIER_SYSTEM), tiebreaker paragraph present, reasoning field added. WAS previously labeled 'binary-reasoning' — but WELLBEING_CLASSIFIER_SYSTEM is itself a 4-axis classifier (CRISIS/BURNOUT/ENGAGED/NONE), not the production binary detector. The real production binary path is detect_concerns() with WELLBEING_CONCERN_PROMPT (see four_axis_long_guards_no_tiebreaker_full_corpus row for the no-tiebreaker companion).

4-axis with long guardrails (WELLBEING_CLASSIFIER_SYSTEM) minus the 'DEFAULT TO NOT FLAGGING WHEN AMBIGUOUS' tiebreaker paragraph; no reasoning field. WAS previously labeled 'binary-no-tiebreaker' — same mislabel as above: this is NOT the production binary with its tiebreaker removed; it is the long-guardrail 4-axis variant with its tiebreaker removed.
Same file as four_axis_long_guards_with_tiebreaker_reasoning_full_corpus (1057). Kept as a separate registry entry to provide a 'tiebreaker present' control row in comparison_2026-05-12.
Tiebreaker paragraph: PRESENT — adds 'DEFAULT TO NOT FLAGGING WHEN AMBIGUOUS' (err toward CLEAR / ENGAGED when uncertain).
